budgetSplit.hint: Pick the split that fits your situation. Changes apply to this month and going forward — past months stay as they were.

tithing.title: Tithing
tithing.subtitle: Set aside {{percent}}% as a tithe before budgeting
tithing.explain: When on, {{percent}}% of new income is carved into a Tithe envelope first, and your {{split}} budget is calculated on the remaining {{remainder}}%. Past months keep their original split.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Choose the language DollarSeeds is displayed in.

currency.title: Currency symbol
currency.subtitle: Changes the symbol shown next to amounts. It does not convert any value you have already recorded.
currency.confirmBody: This changes the symbol shown beside your amounts only. Nothing you have already recorded is converted — an amount saved as 5,000 stays 5,000.

premium.nothingBody: No previous subscription was found for this account.
premium.unavailableBody: Purchases are not available on this device yet.

delete.hint: Permanently delete your account and every record tied to it.
delete.modalBody: Deleting the account is irreversible. You'll lose all the information you've tracked. If you want to delete your account, type "DELETE" in the text box below, then click Delete.
delete.error: That's not right — type "DELETE" exactly to confirm.

firmFoundation.modalBody: Firm Foundation is about stability. Two goals make a big difference — and every dollar toward them is real progress:
firmFoundation.debtRow: A <bold>Debt</bold> goal to pay down what you owe
